job.title: Legal Secretary - top tier firm - Sustainability & Governance
job.description:
Legal Secretary – Sustainability & Governance
Melbourne | Up to $100,000 package | Hybrid – 2 Day WFH

The Opportunity
An exciting newly created opportunity has become available for an experienced Legal Secretary to join a nationally recognised full-service law firm.
You will provide high-level support to one approachable, highly tech-savvy Partner and a small, collaborative team of lawyers working within the firm’s Sustainability & Governance practice.
The firm is known for its stability, exceptionally low staff turnover and genuine, down-to-earth culture. This role offers an excellent work-life balance, including one day of work from home per week and minimal to no overtime.

The Role
You will provide comprehensive legal secretarial support to the Partner and legal team, with limited personal assistant duties. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Monthly billing
  • Diary and email management
  • Court filing
  • Liaising with clients
  • Expense management
  • General legal secretarial and administrative support


About You
To be considered, you will have legal secretarial experience within a reputable law firm and have supported lawyers up to Partner level.
You will be highly organised, proactive and able to manage competing priorities. You will also be confident working both independently and as part of a close-knit team.

What You Will Get

  • Salary package of up to $100,000 package
  • Annual salary reviews
  • One day of work from home per week
  • Wellbeing program
  • Subsidised gym membership
  • Five-star end-of-trip facilities
  • The opportunity to join a stable, supportive and genuinely collegial team

job.title: Senior Legal Secretary - Top tier Firm - Projects & Energy
job.description:
The Opportunity
An opportunity to join a globally renowned, top-tier law firm with low staff turnover, excellent induction and training, and strong career progression opportunities. The firm has a welcoming and inclusive culture, with extensive resources and a strong investment in technology, systems, and procedures.

The Role
This role sits within the firm’s Projects and Energy team, where you will support Partners only, with no lawyer support required. You will also have access to an administration team to assist with basic administrative tasks.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Diary and email management
  • Client management
  • Practice management
  • Billing

About You
We are looking for an experienced legal support professional looking to step up into an EA-style role. You will have experience supporting at least two Partners simultaneously. We are open to candidates from any practice area background. We are not looking for law students or recent graduates.
What You Will Get
A market-leading salary package of up to $110,000, depending on experience. The firm also offers up to two days of working from home once you are settled into the role, along with a generous benefits package, including 26 weeks of paid parental leave, gym membership, and other benefits.
